title: Add RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples, and docs site quickstarts
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: provide opinionated RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent templates and a set of tool-calling examples to help engineers ship integrations quickly. This PR adds a set of quickstarts to the docs site, example agent templates (Python + TypeScript), and rewrites a portion of the agent docs for clarity and consistency.

What changed: added three RAG agent templates (qa-assistant, summarizer, triage-agent) with config files and prompts; added tool-calling examples demonstrating calendar, ticketing, and vector-store lookup integrations; added docs site quickstarts and step-by-step guides; introduced small shared utilities under redwood-examples for prompt validation and sample datasets.

Testing: unit tests for prompt validation and example runners added; manual end-to-end smoke tests run against dev staging (local vector store + mock tool endpoints); docs site preview built and link checks passed.

Notes on rollout and compatibility: templates are additive and live under redwood-examples/agents and docs at /docs/agents/rag-quickstarts. No breaking changes to public SDKs. Follow-ups include telemetry events for template usage (ENG-3420) and adding Go examples in a subsequent PR.

Checklist: - [x] Add templates and examples - [x] Docs site quickstarts + images - [x] Unit tests + CI green - [x] Review feedback addressed

Related: references ENG-3412 and DOCS-129 for editorial scope.
